v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dele iniquitátem meam, * Dómine, secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

text.la: Discérne causam meam, * Deus, de gente non sancta.
text.en: Distinguish my cause, O Lord, * from the nation that is not holy.

text.la: Deus misereátur * nostri, et benedícat nobis. ‡
text.en: May God have mercy on us * and bless us. ‡

text.la: Corrípies me, Dómine, * et vivificábis me.
text.en: Thou shalt correct me, O Lord, * and make me to live.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quia benígnus est, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for he will judge his people, and be gracious unto his servants.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Si duo ex vobis * consénserint super terram: de omni re quamcúmque petíerint, fiet illis a Patre meo, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: If two of you shall agree on earth * as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of My Father, saith the Lord.

text.la: Exáudi nos, omnípotens et miséricors Deus: et continéntiæ salutáris propítius nobis dona concéde.
text.en: Graciously hear us, O Almighty and merciful God, and in thy goodness enable us to reap the fruit of this our healthful Fasting.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáti Benedícti Abbátis comméndet: ut, quod nostris méritis non valémus, eius patrocínio assequámur.
text.en: May the pleading of blessed Benedict, the Abbot, make us acceptable unto thee, O Lord, we pray; that what we may not have through any merits of ours, we may gain by means of his patronage.

office.title: Feria Tertia infra Hebd III in Quadr
